correctness.rationale: The surjective p-morphism condition is reduced to thresholds of two upsets; maximal zero cells must branch to both singleton colours. The complete legal threshold transitions are classified, solved by generating functions, and coefficient-extracted to give an exact all-parameter formula. Boundary a=1 or b=1 and double-counting of target orientation are addressed. Brute-force direct upsets verify 25 small cases and an independent state transfer and Delannoy recurrence verify 247 cases; finite tests are not mistaken for the general proof.

value.rationale: A complete exact enumeration of surjective bounded-morphic quotients for an entire natural family of finite intuitionistic/modal Kripke frames, requiring nontrivial simultaneous existential back conditions. It provides a structural normal form, a sharp existence threshold, and a surprising corrected Delannoy count; useful for studying finite-frame quotients and related Heyting-subalgebra embeddings rather than an arbitrary isolated table.
